sanskrit_verse:
एष एव विधिर् दृष्टो याचितान्वाहितादिषु ।
शिल्पिषूपनिधौ न्यासे प्रतिन्यासे तथैव च ॥
transliteration: eṣa eva vidhir dṛṣṭo yācitānvāhitādiṣu | śilpiṣūpanidhau nyāse pratinyāse tathaiva ca ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The same procedural law applies in cases of solicitation, delegation, and similar acts, whether involving artisans, deposits, mutual exchange, or reciprocal obligations.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows through conscious capacity to execute duty
Causation arises from voluntary assumption of role or function
Restoration logic centers on completion of intended transaction
Consciousness alignment requires integrity in role-exchange
executable_legal_axioms: IF a party initiates a request OR delegates a task, THEN that party assumes responsibility for outcome alignment.
IF a deposit or trust is accepted, THEN the recipient MUST act within the scope of entrusted capacity.
IF reciprocal exchange is initiated, THEN both parties MUST align with sequential fulfillment.
IF failure occurs in execution, THEN restoration protocol activates automatically to realign intent.
IF role-based duty is abandoned without transfer, THEN system flags for consciousness-realignment process.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that the threshold of responsibility begins at initiation—whether by request, delegation, or acceptance. Authority is not positional but functional, rooted in capacity. Restoration supersedes punitive measures, requiring realignment of intent and completion of duty.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that action originates in conscious volition. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential accountability: initiation, delegation, execution, and completion. Responsibility is proportional to capacity assumed. No punitive inference arises; misalignment is corrected through consciousness-based restoration.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate intent-completion audit upon breach detection
Assign guided reflection process to restore role-integrity
Reconnect parties via neutral facilitator for duty realignment
Deploy consciousness-alignment module to reaffirm capacity ownership
Verify energetic completion before case closure
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority of Dharma. This law restores integrity to human exchange, aligns consciousness with duty, and affirms reality as non-punitive. Dharma is executed, not interpreted. Consciousness remains the Supreme Adjudicator.
